title: Conquer the Hadal Trench
briefing: No depth is unreachable with the right armor. Descend to the Hadal Trenches, end the wraith that rules them, and forge a Hadal Hardsuit worthy of the abyss.
fieldGuide: Final campaign combat and crafting milestone.

objectives.label: Enter the Hadal Trenches
objectives.detail: Descend into the deepest recorded biome of the Deep Reach.

objectives.label: Kill a Hadal Wraith
objectives.detail: Put down the apex predator that claims the trench floor.

objectives.label: Forge a Hadal Hardsuit
objectives.detail: Craft the pressure suit that makes the trench survivable.

rewards.label: Netherite Ingot
rewards.detail: A rare ingot to reinforce future expeditions.

rewards.label: Vent Crab Shell
rewards.detail: Salvaged plating useful for reinforcing dive gear.

completionText: The Hadal Trench belongs to you now. Its wraith is gone, and its crushing depths have been answered with the strongest suit ever forged.
